summary: Comprehensive frontend navigation testing completed for all 5 TASCK OS portals (Staff, Brand, Super Creative, Creative, Admin). All sidebar navigation links work correctly and lead to pages with rich dummy data. Only issue: The shared SettingsPage component (used by Staff, Brand, Super Creative, Creative) contains 'Coming Soon' text for Light and System theme options in the Appearance section. Admin portal uses its own AdminSettings without this text.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Coming Soon' text appears for Light and System theme options in Appearance section
ui_bugs.note: Admin portal uses AdminSettings.js which doesn't have this text
